caption: The drawing depicts a textile object and a circular sample, both featuring intricate patterns in blue and white. The main textile is rectangular, occupying the right side of the drawing, with fringes hanging from the bottom edge. The textile is covered in a repeating floral motif composed primarily of stylized flowers and leaves, with the patterns arranged symmetrically and separated by small geometric elements. The outer borders of the textile show a narrower band with a repeating lines and floral design, while the inner area has larger floral clusters. To the left of the textile, there is a circular sample of the same or similar pattern, showing a close-up section of the floral motifs. The overall composition of the drawing is detailed, with the blue designs sharply contrasting against the white background.
title: Coverlet
